questions.q: What is the Setup and Maintenance work area?
options: The dedicated work area where all of an implementation's configuration tasks live
A reporting tool for executives only
A place to submit scheduled processes
A security role that grants full administrator access
questions.explain: Setup and Maintenance is the structured front door for configuring Oracle Fusion Cloud, organizing configuration tasks rather than scattering setup screens across the application.

questions.q: What is the correct order of the configuration hierarchy in Setup and Maintenance?
options: Task, Offering, Functional Area
Offering, Functional Area, Task
Functional Area, Task, Offering
Offering, Task, Functional Area
questions.explain: The hierarchy goes from broadest to narrowest: Offering (e.g. Financials), Functional Area (e.g. Payables), then Task (e.g. Manage Payment Terms).

questions.q: In the example 'Manage Payment Terms' inside Payables inside Financials, what level of the hierarchy is 'Payables'?
options: Offering
Task
Functional Area
Implementation project
questions.explain: Payables is a Functional Area — a grouping of related configuration within the broader Financials Offering.

questions.q: What is an 'implementation project' in this specific technical sense?
options: A marketing document describing Oracle's product roadmap
A synonym for the Navigator menu
A security role assigned to the project sponsor
A named, scoped set of offerings, functional areas, and tasks selected for one company's rollout, used to assign and track configuration work
questions.explain: An implementation project selects which offerings and functional areas are in scope for a specific company and tracks task assignment and completion progress.

questions.q: Why does this lesson say the Offering/Functional Area/Task hierarchy matters for real implementations?
options: It turns configuring the system into concrete, assignable, trackable pieces instead of a vague, overwhelming blob of work
It has no practical impact on how projects are run
It only matters for technical consultants, never functional ones
It replaces the need for a project sponsor
questions.explain: The hierarchy lets a project break configuration into assignable, trackable pieces — enabling accurate progress reporting rather than guesswork.
